color.note: Peel identity. Light = Paper ground, Dark = Ink ground (the device look). Coral is a FILL colour: always outlined in ink, never used for text on Paper.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand colour. The Dotlet sticker, primary button fills, highlights. Always paired with an ink outline or ink text on top (6.1:1). Never coral text on Paper (2.9:1).

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral for text and links: 5.1:1 on surface-100 (Paper), 8.2:1 on surface-100 (Ink).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-100/200. Also the text colour on any coral or sticker fill (use {ink-fixed} there).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps. 5.0:1 on Paper, 8.5:1 on Ink.

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Ink that does not flip with theme: text and outlines on coral and sticker fills, Dotlet eyes.

tokens.name: paper-fixed
tokens.usage: Paper that does not flip: the back of the peel, text on ink-fixed fills.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Backing: sunken wells, code blocks, the 'sticker sheet' behind characters.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The sticker edge: 2px borders on buttons, cards, chips and inputs.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and table rules only; never a control border.

tokens.name: sticker-coral
tokens.usage: Character colour: Coral (default Dotlet). Ink eyes.

tokens.name: sticker-mint
tokens.usage: Character colour: Mint. Ink eyes. Personality only, never a status.

tokens.name: sticker-sky
tokens.usage: Character colour: Sky. Ink eyes. Personality only, never a status.

tokens.name: sticker-lilac
tokens.usage: Character colour: Lilac. Ink eyes. Personality only, never a status.

tokens.name: sticker-sun
tokens.usage: Character colour: Sun. Ink eyes. Personality only, never a status.

tokens.name: sticker-ink
tokens.usage: Character colour: Ink (black family). Paper eyes, #3a3430 flap.

tokens.name: sticker-paper
tokens.usage: Character colour: Paper (white family). Ink eyes, #e9e3d6 flap.

tokens.name: state-listening
tokens.usage: Listening glyph (sound bars) and chip icon. Always with the bars shape and the word.

tokens.name: state-thinking
tokens.usage: Thinking glyph (three dots).

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: Working glyph (spinner). Deliberately neutral: work is normal.

tokens.name: state-approval
tokens.usage: Approval needed glyph (?) and its chip. The one state that asks for the owner.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: Done glyph (check).

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Error glyph (!). Pair with × × eyes on device.

tokens.name: state-offline
tokens.usage: Offline: no flap on device, dashed seam; chip uses a hollow dot.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px outside the outline.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: A little face on your desk.

styles.name: device-label
styles.usage: The one word a 412px round screen may show under the face.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Your own AI agent, powered by your own API key.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Touch the screen to wake your Dotlet.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), form gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gaps on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets — die-cut sticker corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, avatars, the Dotlet itself.

shadow.note: Shadows are hard offsets, like a sticker sitting on a sheet. No blur.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Resting buttons, cards and chips with an outline.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover: the sticker lifts. Press: shadow 0 and translate 3px.

tokens.name: border-sticker
tokens.usage: Every outlined control and card.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers.
